## Intake review

**Related:** #2062 (design §4), #2317/#2318 (sibling slices), #2321 (the PoC that consumes this envelope)

**Notes:** Gateway request envelope: canonical CBOR bodies, verify_strict only, nonce window + ReplayGuard, deterministic idempotency IDs. The body carries a full `## Acceptance` list (round-trip + tamper/stale/replay rejections, forgery fixture, valid-signature-from-non-minter rejection), so this pass is labels-only.

**Risks:** The verify-vs-verify_strict distinction and the idempotency-ID vs TigerBeetle monotonic-ID tension (§9.3) are the two places a quiet shortcut becomes a security or correctness hole.

**Suggested approach:** Reuse directory_auth.rs's Signed scheme as scoped; resolve the §9.3 tension explicitly in the implementation note; test the forgery fixture first.
